notes.title: Amphora Update Released
notes.notes:
An update to Amphora has been released!

We listened to a lot of your feedback and added better conveyance to some levels to make a better experience. We also fixed some bugs in the process.

Thanks for all your support and kind words.

[h1]Patch Notes (November 28 2014)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bath Level - tweaked for a better experience
[*]Sheep Level - puzzle changed slightly
[*]Roast Level - puzzle changed slightly
[*]Tide Level - added element for conveyance
[*]Cliff Level - added element for conveyance
[*]Increased physics iterations to make it more stable
[*]Game will now run in offline mode
[*]Many small bugs fixed
[/list]
